replayScope.sourceRef: https://platform.kimi.ai/docs/guide/use-thinking-models (read 2026-10-29): `thinking.keep`: "`null` (default, ignores historical turns' thinking)"; "Within a single task (the multi-step reasoning produced during one tool-call loop), keep all of the reasoning content from the context (the `reasoning_content` field) and send it back with the request". The adapter sends no `thinking.keep`, so earlier turns' reasoning is accepted and ignored.
